_readme: THE ONA TILI SAMPLE PAPER — edit this file to change what the Milliy sertifikat
ona tili builder's "Namunaviy variant" button loads. Contract: docs/MILLIY_QUIZ.md.
WHY 30 QUESTIONS / 90 MINUTES. ⚠️ Unlike maths, NO published ona tili blueprint
is encoded in this repo (maths has EXAM_BLUEPRINT; nothing equivalent exists
here), so this length is THIS FILE'S OWN, not a national spec — it matches the
`ona-tili` defaults in MILLIY_SUBJECTS so pressing the button fills the builder
to exactly its target.
⚠️ THIS IS ONA TILI, NOT "ona tili va adabiyot". The taxonomy has no literature
topic (see scripts/addNativeLanguageTopics.mjs for why), so a question about a
novel or a poet has nowhere to sit and must not be filed under a grammar
section — it would land in the teacher's per-topic report as "Sintaksis".
THE DISTRIBUTION THIS FILE FOLLOWS, one line per taxonomy topic:
fonetika-va-grafika            5
leksikologiya                  6
soz-tarkibi-va-soz-yasalishi   3
morfologiya                    6
sintaksis                      5
imlo-va-tinish-belgilari       3
uslubiyat-va-nutq-madaniyati   2
→ 30 slots: 26 closed (Y-1) + 4 short typed (O)
⚠️ NOTHING ENFORCES THAT. The builder has no per-section quotas (by design —
see checkMilliyAdd), so the counts above are this file's own discipline.
Recount them by hand if you add or remove an entry.
Per entry:
topicId     an `ona-tili` TOPIC slug. It becomes the item's sectionId, which
is what the teacher's results page groups by:
fonetika-va-grafika
leksikologiya
soz-tarkibi-va-soz-yasalishi
morfologiya
sintaksis
imlo-va-tinish-belgilari
uslubiyat-va-nutq-madaniyati
subtopicId  optional, for a more precise label. Must belong to its topic.
Ona tili subtopics carry a "Group — Leaf" prefix, so they read
e.g. `mano-munosabatlari-sinonimlar`.
question    a string, or {uz, ru, en}. A bare string is used for all three.
options     A-D (OptionKey is A..D). PRESENT => closed item; ABSENT => typed
item. There is no separate flag, so the two cannot contradict.
answer      closed -> the correct option key; typed -> the literal answer.
acceptedAnswers  typed only: other spellings graded correct.
numeric     typed only, default FALSE — the opposite of chemistry and physics:
here almost every typed answer is a WORD, so it is graded as text
(whitespace-collapsed, case-insensitive).
⚠️ A TYPED ANSWER MUST NOT CONTAIN AN APOSTROPHE. Text grading collapses spaces
and case but NOT apostrophes (lib/ExamTeacher.ts, textMatch), so `ko'makchi`
would be marked wrong for a student who typed `ko\u2018makchi` or `komakchi`. Every typed
entry below deliberately has an apostrophe-free answer (`yuklama`, `atama`,
`atov gap`) — keep that rule when adding one, or list every spelling in
acceptedAnswers.
⚠️ AUTHORED UZBEK-ONLY: a bare string fills ru and en with the same text, so a
student who picked Russian sees Uzbek rather than a blank. ⚠️ And unlike the
science papers, most of these questions CANNOT be translated — they ask about
Uzbek words. A ru/en variant would have to be a different question.

questions.question: Hozirgi o'zbek adabiy tilida nechta unli tovush bor?
questions.explanation: O'zbek tilida 6 ta unli tovush bor: a, o, i, e, u, o'.

questions.question: Hozirgi o'zbek adabiy tilida nechta undosh tovush bor?
questions.explanation: O'zbek tilidagi 30 ta tovushning 6 tasi unli, 24 tasi undosh tovushdir.

questions.question: «Maktab» so'zi nechta bo'g'indan iborat?
questions.explanation: So'z mak-tab tarzida bo'g'inlarga ajraladi — 2 bo'g'in. Bo'g'inlar soni unlilar soniga teng.

questions.question: O'zbek tilida so'z urg'usi odatda qaysi bo'g'inga tushadi?
questions.explanation: O'zbek tilida urg'u asosan oxirgi bo'g'inga tushadi; ayrim so'zlarda va qo'shimchalarda istisnolar bor.

questions.question: Hozirgi o'zbek lotin yozuvida (tutuq belgisidan tashqari) nechta harf bor? Javobni son bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: O'zbek lotin alifbosida 29 ta harf va bitta tutuq belgisi (') mavjud.

questions.question: «Chiroyli» so'ziga sinonim bo'la oladigan so'zni toping.
questions.explanation: Sinonimlar — ma'nosi bir-biriga yaqin so'zlar: chiroyli, go'zal, ko'rkam.

questions.question: «Yaqin» so'zining antonimi qaysi?
questions.explanation: Antonimlar — ma'nosi qarama-qarshi so'zlar: yaqin — uzoq.

questions.question: Omonimlar qanday so'zlar?

options.A: Shakli bir xil, ma'nosi butunlay boshqa so'zlar

questions.explanation: Omonimlar bir xil yoziladi va aytiladi, lekin ma'nolari o'zaro bog'liq emas: «yoz» (fasl) va «yoz» (yozmoq).

questions.question: Quyidagi juftliklarning qaysi biri paronimlardir?
questions.explanation: Paronimlar — talaffuzi va yozilishi o'xshash, lekin ma'nosi har xil so'zlar. Qolgan javoblar: antonim, sinonim va omonim.

questions.question: «Og'zi qulog'ida» iborasi qanday ma'noni bildiradi?
questions.explanation: Frazeologizm yaxlit ko'chma ma'no bildiradi: «og'zi qulog'ida» — juda xursand, quvonchi ichiga sig'mayotgan.

questions.question: Faqat ma'lum bir fan yoki kasb sohasida qat'iy bir ma'noda qo'llanadigan so'zlar qanday nomlanadi? Javobni bitta so'z bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: Atamalar (terminlar) — bir sohaga oid, ko'chma ma'nosi yo'q, aniq bir tushunchani bildiruvchi so'zlar: kesim, fotosintez, valentlik.

questions.question: «Kitobxonlik» so'zining o'zagi qaysi?
questions.explanation: So'z kitob + xon + lik tarzida tahlil qilinadi; bo'linmaydigan ma'noli qism — «kitob» o'zagi.

questions.question: Quyidagi so'zlarning qaysi biri qo'shma so'z?
questions.explanation: Qo'shma so'z ikki o'zakning birikuvidan yasaladi: besh + barmoq. «Yozuvchi» — qo'shimcha bilan yasalgan, «kitoblar» — shakl yasalgan so'z.

questions.question: Quyidagi so'zlarning qaysi biri juft so'z?
questions.explanation: Juft so'zlar ikki mustaqil so'zning teng bog'lanishidan hosil bo'ladi va chiziqcha bilan yoziladi: opa-singil, ota-ona.

questions.question: «Do'stlik» so'zi qaysi so'z turkumiga mansub?
questions.explanation: «-lik» qo'shimchasi bilan yasalgan mavhum ot; «kim? nima?» so'rog'iga javob beradi.

questions.question: «Ko'kimtir» so'zi sifatning qaysi darajasida?
questions.explanation: «-imtir» belgining me'yordan kamligini bildiradi — ozaytirma daraja (ko'kish, sarg'ish kabi).

questions.question: «Uchtadan» so'zi sonning qaysi turiga kiradi?
questions.explanation: «-tadan» qo'shimchasi predmetning teng bo'lib taqsimlanishini bildiradi — taqsim son.

questions.question: «O'zim» so'zi olmoshning qaysi turiga kiradi?
questions.explanation: «O'z» o'zlik olmoshi bo'lib, egalik qo'shimchalari bilan turlanadi: o'zim, o'zing, o'zi.

questions.question: «Yozdirdi» fe'li qaysi nisbatda?
questions.explanation: «-dir» qo'shimchasi harakatni boshqa shaxsga bajartirishni bildiradi — orttirma nisbat.

questions.question: «Faqat», «hatto» so'zlari va «-gina» qo'shimchasi qaysi yordamchi so'z turkumiga kiradi? Javobni bitta so'z bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: Yuklamalar so'z va gaplarga qo'shimcha ma'no (ta'kid, chegara, so'roq, gumon) yuklaydi. Ko'makchilar ot bilan fe'lni bog'laydi, bog'lovchilar esa gap bo'laklarini.

questions.question: «Kitobni o'qidi» birikmasida qanday sintaktik aloqa mavjud?
questions.explanation: Hokim so'z tobe so'zdan ma'lum kelishik shaklini talab qilmoqda (tushum kelishigi) — bu boshqaruv aloqasi.

questions.question: «Bahor keldi» gapida «bahor» qaysi gap bo'lagi vazifasida kelgan?
questions.explanation: «Kim? nima?» so'rog'iga javob beruvchi bosh bo'lak — ega; «keldi» esa kesim.

questions.question: «Bog'da olma, nok, uzum pishdi» gapida uyushiq bo'laklar qaysi gap bo'lagi vazifasida kelgan?
questions.explanation: «Olma, nok, uzum» bir xil so'roqqa javob beradi va bitta kesimga bog'lanadi — uyushiq egalar.

questions.question: «Yomg'ir yog'di, havo salqinlashdi» gapi qaysi turdagi qo'shma gap?
questions.explanation: Ikki sodda gap bog'lovchisiz, faqat ohang va vergul yordamida birikkan.

questions.question: «Kuz. Sovuq shamol.» kabi gaplar bir bosh bo'lakli gaplarning qaysi turiga kiradi? Javobni yozing.
questions.explanation: Atov gaplar predmet yoki hodisani atab ko'rsatadi va bosh bo'lagi bosh kelishikdagi ot bilan ifodalanadi.

questions.question: Quyidagi so'zlarning qaysi biri to'g'ri yozilgan?
questions.explanation: Qo'shma otlar qo'shib yoziladi: ko'zoynak, otboqar, gulsapsar.

questions.question: Gapda undalma qanday ajratiladi?
questions.explanation: Undalma gapning qaerida kelishidan qat'i nazar vergul bilan ajratiladi: «Bolalar, darsga tayyorlaninglar.»

questions.question: Ko'chirma gap qanday tinish belgisi ichiga olinadi?
questions.explanation: Ko'chirma gap qo'shtirnoq ichiga olinadi, muallif gapidan esa ikki nuqta yoki tire bilan ajratiladi.

questions.question: Ariza, tilxat, ma'lumotnoma kabi hujjatlar qaysi uslubda yoziladi?
questions.explanation: Rasmiy (idoraviy) uslub qat'iy shakl, standart iboralar va hissiy bo'yoqsizlik bilan ajralib turadi.

questions.question: Ilmiy uslubning asosiy belgisi nima?

options.A: Atamalarning ko'p qo'llanishi va bayonning aniqligi

questions.explanation: Ilmiy uslubda fikr aniq, izchil va isbotli bayon qilinadi; atamalar bir ma'noda qo'llanadi, obrazli vositalar deyarli ishlatilmaydi.
